posts.title: The Trunk Slammer From Hell, Chapter 6: Wake-on-LAN
posts.description: My name is Lance Mercer. This Halloween I dressed as the deputy who's dating my ex-wife and wore it to the club, and at midnight my phone told me it was archiving every text I've ever sent. My guy picked up on the second ring, from a funeral home. Halloween Triple Feature, part two of three. Narrated by Lance Mercer. Not canon. posts.title: The Trunk Slammer From Hell, Chapter 5: End of Life
posts.description: The lead said the office manager at a funeral home believes the building is haunted. Brad told her it was port 9100. I told her she had a presence, and by Tuesday afternoon I had the account and the funeral director had sold me a casket. Halloween Triple Feature, part one of three. Not canon.
